commands.help:
Manage analyses.

An analysis is a history of versions, like a git repository. HEAD is the version commands act on by default; pass --version to target another. Findings staged with `bevor findings` sit on HEAD until you commit them, which creates a new version. After a code change, `bevor sync` pushes it and adds it as a new version.

Create a version for the pushed code.

With an analysis selected, adds it as a new version on HEAD and moves HEAD to it. With none
selected (or ``--new``), starts a new analysis and selects it. Nothing is run; use
`bevor analyses run` for that. The working directory must match the last push; `bevor sync`
pushes and does this in one step.

parameters.help: Start a new analysis even if one is selected.
parameters.name: new

parameters.help: Add the new version on top of this version instead of HEAD.
parameters.name: version

commands.help:
Stage, review, and search findings.

add, import, edit, and delete stage changes on HEAD of the selected analysis; `bevor analyses commit` turns them into a new version.
Mark a finding as acknowledged.

Stage a new finding on HEAD of the selected analysis (or ``--version``).

Provide input one of three ways:

- ``--file``: a YAML file with exactly one finding mapping.
- ``--interactive``: prompts for each field.
- Flags directly, as described below.

When passing flags, specify a location, which specifies the code node that the finding is associated with, using exactly one of:

- ``--node`` and/or ``--location`` (a Bevor node id; ``--location`` alone
  fans the finding out to every entrypoint that reaches it)
- ``--uri`` plus one full pair of ``--start-line``/``--end-line``,
  ``--char-offset``/``--char-length``, or ``--byte-offset``/``--byte-length``
- ``--fqn``

Metadata (``--type``, ``--level``, ``--name``, ``--explanation``) is all or
nothing: provide all four to record a finding, or omit all four to mark the
location as analyzed with no finding. ``--recommendation``, ``--poc``,
and ``--tool`` are always optional.

parameters.help: Stage onto this version instead of HEAD.
parameters.name: version

parameters.help: YAML file containing exactly one finding mapping.
parameters.name: file

``source`` can be a ``.yaml``/``.yml`` file (one or more ``---``-separated findings), a directory
of YAML files, a ``.sarif`` file, or a ``.json`` file with a top-level ``findings`` list.

parameters.help: A .json file, .sarif file, .yaml/.yml file, or a directory of YAML files.

parameters.help: Stage onto this version instead of HEAD.
